results.title: The phone's Theme & text sheet
results.checks: On an iPhone 13 the sliders in the chapter's top bar open the old reader's Theme & text sheet: the larger A makes the verses larger and the smaller A smaller; the line-spacing button cycles the spacing; UI size L, then M; Keep screen awake toggles; Go to all settings opens the Settings list in the drawer
results.note: text m → l → m; spacing normal → relaxed and back; UI size L then M; keep awake toggled; Go to all settings opened Settings

results.title: Choose the reader's fonts
results.checks: Account → Text: Verses in Inter, light, italic; Headings in Roboto; the verse text and the heading are drawn in those fonts (Google Fonts loaded only for them); kept after a reload; Reset returns the defaults
results.note: verses Inter, sans-serif|300|italic; headings Roboto, sans-serif; kept after a reload; Reset → Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif

results.title: Settings in the sidebar
results.checks: The ⚙ at the bottom left of the sidebar turns the sidebar into Settings, in place of the tabs — Account settings, Display & Theme, Toolbar, Extensions, Install App, Launch tutorial, Customize, About Seed Bible, then Language; Display & Theme opens its page there, a line-height choice there changes the chapter, ← goes back to the list; ✕ brings the tabs back
results.note: ⚙ → Settings: Account settings · Display & Theme · Toolbar · Extensions · Install App · Launch tutorial · Customize · About Seed Bible; Display & Theme's line height reached the chapter; ← back to the list; ✕ brought the tabs back

results.title: A phone: the old reader's phone shell
results.checks: On an iPhone 13: a thin bar at the top (the translation, then ☆, bookmark, share and text settings), the chapter's title centred and large (John over a big 3), and along the bottom play and the chapter pill ‹ John 3 › above the five tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More, with Bible lit. The pill's › goes to John 4 and its label opens the book picker; Bible on the text opens it too. More → Tabs opens the Tabs drawer, which closes with its ✕ and with a tap beside it; reading down scrolls the page itself; signed out, You carries the count of changes waiting and opens the sign-in pane
results.note: top bar: 5 buttons; title "John 3"; tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More; › and the pill and Bible worked; the Tabs drawer closed by ✕ and by a tap beside it; the page scrolled; You carried the waiting count and opened sign-in
